reply.text: That sounds painful, and I'm sorry. A swollen knee after a fall is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so please get it looked at, and soon if you can't bear weight on it or it's locked or unstable. I won't guess at what it is or how long it'll take. Once a clinician has cleared you, tell me what they say and I'll build your training around it. Until then, keep the knee out of any lifts or runs.
